message.reasoning_content:
Claims c1 and c2 are recorded; the describer's update refined probe targets. No new evidence. Anything more to add? Possibly a third claim about x near -1 (mantissa branch near smallest, z near -0.096) — but error there is tiny (z^3 ~ 1e-3 scale), negligible. Another possible claim: correction term accuracy — the Sterbenz correction is exact since FP16→FP32, u-1.0 exact for x in [0.5,2]? For small |x|, u-1.0 exact, correction 0. Fine. Large x: x-(u-1) — u up to 65505, u-1 loses bits, but correction = (x - (u-1))/u approximates the FP32 rounding error of 1+x, magnitude ~ulp(u)/u ~ 1e-7... Actually rounding error of 1.0+x up to ~0.5 ulp(65505) ~ 2e-3, divided by u ~ 65505 gives ~3e-8 in log — fine. Actually that correction is meant to fix log(exact 1+x) vs log(rounded u): error = rounding_err/u ≈ 2e-3/65505 ≈ 3e-8. Fine.

The two claims cover the main risks; no new claims needed. Record no new claims.
